parsed.rationale: All five members — `AppleMusicService`, `BandcampService`, `SoundCloudService`, `SpotifyService`, and `YouTubeMusicService` — are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same package (`MusicShareKit`) with identical structural shape (`shared_field_count: 1`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact structural duplicates. Because they represent distinct music-service domains that are expected to diverge in behaviour (different APIs, auth flows, etc.), the right abstraction is a shared protocol `MusicService` that each concrete type conforms to, rather than collapsing them into a single generic type. Introducing a PAT allows each service to carry its own `Configuration` associated type while sharing a common interface, eliminating the repeated boilerplate that the pipeline flagged as exact duplicates. All five files live under `Shared/MusicShareKit/Sources/MusicShareKit/Services/`, so the new protocol can be placed in that same package without any cross-package dependency changes.
